name: Out-of-Core ZSWEEP
definition: An out-of-core rendering algorithm for large unstructured grids that extends the in-core ZSWEEP algorithm by processing data in tiles and loading meta-cells from disk only when needed, allowing rendering of datasets larger than available RAM.
summary: Out-of-Core ZSWEEP is a direct volume rendering technique for large unstructured grids that extends ZSWEEP to handle datasets exceeding RAM by processing data in tiles, offering substantial speed advantages over MIR at the cost of complex preprocessing.
